reproducer.text: Minimal importing kernel + exact-bit corpus fails MNE173 on experiment run; sibling-only control passes. See mncs-signal pressure/reproducers/import-gap/.

requiredBehavior: A single documented use-resolution mechanism that works identically under mncs test and mncs experiment run, or an explicit diagnostic naming the path split at the use site.
summary: mncs experiment run resolves use relative to the importing file only, so any kernel importing mncs.math.* or mncs.numerics.* fails with MNE173 while the identical file passes mncs test. mncs-harness mirrored its verdict lattice and mncs-signal mirrors Newton sqrt for the same reason; mncs-numerics stays self-contained for it. One documented import mechanism for both paths is missing.
title: Cross-repo use imports fail on the experiment path (MNE173); numeric repos mirror canonical sources
